title: QA Engineer — Web & Mobile
description:
QA Engineer, Web and Mobile
Individual contributor. Reports to the Director of QA. No direct reports.
Salary : €5000 per month
Location : Poland (Fully Remote)
The role
You test the web application, frontend and backend, and the mobile applications on iOS and Android. That is the surface of the job.
Underneath it, the point of this role is to understand how the product actually works: the data flow, the API contracts, the places where two systems meet and produce behaviour nobody specified. That understanding is what lets you improve a specification before code is written, catch the gap nobody else noticed, and give Support, Sales, Product and Engineering an answer they can rely on.
We are looking for extreme ownership, the person who picks up the task nobody else wants because it needs doing and they can see why it matters.
What you will do
Test the product properly. Web end to end, frontend behaviour and backend responses, not just the UI layer. Mobile on iOS and Android against an agreed device and OS matrix, with a real understanding of platform conventions and where the two diverge.
Own our automated coverage on web. Extend and maintain the Playwright suite and write new tests for the features you take through. Investigate failures and fix flakiness rather than muting it, and be honest about what automation is and is not covering.
Verify at the API and data layer. Requests, responses, payloads, status codes, backward compatibility for older clients. Query the database directly to confirm what actually happened, rather than what the screen says happened.
Prevent bugs, not just report them. Pressure-test specifications with Product, Design and engineers before development starts: happy paths, edge cases, error states, empty states. Point out the platform that was forgotten, the API version that will break, the migration nobody planned. Asking the awkward question early is part of the job.
Debug to root cause. "It doesn't work" is not a bug report. Narrow down where it breaks and what the system is actually doing, and hand the developer something they can act on.
Support the wider business. Reproduce and triage customer issues that reach engineering, and keep test plans and known-issue lists current so release decisions rest on evidence.
Use AI every day. Reduce your own repetitive work with it, build reusable AI skills the wider team can benefit from, make small fixes in the code yourself where that is reasonable, and bring ideas about where AI can raise our quality bar.
What we are looking for

• Three to five years of hands-on testing of web applications, with a demonstrated ability to find root causes rather than symptoms.

• Practical test automation experience. You have written and maintained UI or API tests in Playwright, or a comparable framework, and can work in a test codebase without hand-holding.

• You can read and reason about API contracts and payloads, query a database in SQL to verify data, and are comfortable with traffic and API inspection tooling, or quick to pick it up.

• Mobile testing in practice. You can tell a platform convention apart from a defect, and reason about the device and OS coverage a given change actually needs.

• Proven collaboration with Design and Product. You have been in the room during specification work and made it better without owning it, with examples you can talk us through.

• Excellent written and spoken communication, in Polish and English, both at C2 or native level.

Nice to have

• Testing in a regulated or healthcare-adjacent domain.

• Device farms or cloud device labs, such as BrowserStack or Firebase Test Lab.

• Triaging from crash and error monitoring, such as Sentry or Crashlytics.

• Accessibility testing (WCAG).

title: Solution Architect, AWS Generative AI
description:

This is a principal-level role. You make decisions the engineers execute without relitigating them, and you defend those decisions to client IT, Security, and the Agent Assist provider.

- Produce the target architecture for Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Bases with OpenSearch Serverless as the vector store, S3 as the landing zone, and the retrieval API on API Gateway and Lambda - and get it approved by client IT and Security by end of week 2.

- Lead the transition readiness review in weeks 9-10 and sign the readiness checklist jointly with the client.

- Experience designing permission-aware retrieval over Microsoft 365 content - SharePoint and Teams via Microsoft Graph with Entra app registration - or an equivalent enterprise content platform.

- A track record of writing architecture and API documents that a client’s security team approved on first or second review.

- Experience as the named technical lead on a fixed-fee or fixed-scope engagement of 8-16 weeks.

- Able to present to CIO or VP-level audiences and to interview with the client before kickoff.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- AWS Certified Solutions Architect Professional and AWS Certified Generative AI Developer Professio

Validate and check Commercial & Marketing's monthly, weekly, and daily category top-line forecasts of sales, volume and ASP against run rates, promotional plans, and customer strategies

Own the detailed item planning process, splitting category forecasts into granular sub-category and item variant forecasts across sales, volume and ASP, providing item sales mix and margin visibility, and Operations with accurate production requirements

Będziesz projektować i optymalizować platformy monitoringu, które zwiększają widoczność działania aplikacji i infrastruktury, usprawniają diagnostykę oraz przyspieszają reagowanie na incydenty.
W codziennej pracy będziesz:

• Rozwijać rozwiązania monitoringu i telemetryczne z wykorzystaniem Azure Monitor, Grafana, Splunk i OpenTelemetry.

• Tworzyć dashboardy, alerty i mechanizmy wykrywania anomalii.

• Wykorzystywać AI i automatyzację do usprawniania operacji oraz analizy przyczyn incydentów.

• Wspierać rozwój rozwiązań self-healing i autonomicznych procesów operacyjnych.

• Współpracować z międzynarodowymi zespołami engineering, security i operations.

Wymagania

• Doświadczenie w obszarze DevSecOps, SRE, Platform Engineering lub na podobnym stanowisku.

• Praktyczna znajomość narzędzi monitoringu i observability, takich jak Azure Monitor, Grafana lub Splunk.

• Doświadczenie z OpenTelemetry w zakresie metryk, logów i distributed tracing.

• Znajomość automatyzacji i monitorowania infrastruktury w dużych środowiskach.

• Doświadczenie w diagnostyce problemów, zarządzaniu incydentami i analizie ich przyczyn (RCA).

• Umiejętność współpracy w międzynarodowym środowisku - językiem pracy w projekcie jest angielski.

Dodatkowym atutem będzie:

• Doświadczenie w wykorzystaniu AI do monitoringu i wykrywania anomalii.

• Znajomość rozwiązań self-healing, automatyzacji oraz systemów opartych na agentach.

Oferujemy

• Współpracę w formule B2B opartą na partnerskich zasadach.

• Możliwość realizacji ambitnych projektów dla klientów z różnych branż.

• Udział w projektach technologicznych z obszaru AI, data oraz transformacji cyfrowej.

• Współpracę z organizacją realnie zaangażowaną w zrównoważony rozwój i odpowiedzialne wykorzystanie technologii.

• Elastyczność w zakresie organizacji i sposobu realizacji zadań projektowych.

• Dostęp do środowiska ekspertów i wymianę wiedzy w ramach realizowanych przedsięwzięć.

• Projekty realizowane z wykorzystaniem nowoczesnego stosu technologicznego i najnowszych rozwiązań rynkowych.

• Poszerzanie doświadczeń poprzez udział w innowacyjnych przedsięwzięciach i wdrożeniach.

Knowit
Knowit to nordycka firma konsultingowa, która pomaga firmom, instytucjom publicznym i organizacjom odnosić sukcesy w transformacji cyfrowej. Dzięki ekspertyzie w obszarze tworzenia oprogramowania, AI, cyberbezpieczeństwa, usług chmurowych, cyfrowych doświadczeń klienta oraz doradztwa zarządczego, tworzymy rozwiązania, które przyczyniają się do bardziej zrównoważonego i skoncentrowanego na człowieku społeczeństwa.
